fatigue_reference.note: N_f = A / dT^n with A = N_ref * dT_ref^n. The reference pair is an assumption for a SnAgCu automotive board; n = 2.0 sits at the low end of the 2-3 range usually quoted for SnAgCu, so the damage estimate is conservative. Cycle COUNT alone is not a wear measure: swing amplitude dominates.

electrical.note: Undervoltage events cluster around the two auxiliary 12 V battery failures (2012, 2020).

diagnostics.note: Diagnostic codes are raised by this unit for the whole vehicle, which is why the service log carries vehicle systems as well as the unit's own faults.

health.soh_method: min(remaining life across independent wear mechanisms). No weighting: a part fails at its weakest mechanism, not at the mean of them, so the score is the smallest remaining fraction and the limiting mechanism is named alongside it.

health.reuse_note: Per-component verdicts give a reuse fraction of 0.767 by mass, which falls inside the 0.5-0.9 functional reuse yield declared [A] for scenario Sc4 in LCA_framework_v4. The passport therefore evidences an assumption the LCA could not source from literature.

findings.label: Hours above the declared limit
findings.note: Peak 94 C against a declared 80 C ambient limit. Implicated in the 2025 processor over-temperature failure. REPORTED, NOT SCORED: at 0.7 % of powered hours it would return ~99 % under any ratio and act as a bias, not an indicator.

unit_use_phase.note: Use-phase telemetry a vehicle control unit would record about ITSELF. Every figure is derived from data already in this passport: powered hours and distance from environmental.usage_profile, DTC counts from repair_history.events, firmware from service.software_updates. Component ids match components[].
